deadline.value: Annual call; the 2026/27 call closed May 20, 2026. The call for Fall 2027 entry (43rd cycle) is not yet published.

funding.value: The programme receives a variable number of university scholarships each year; some projects are funded on fixed topics.
funding.quote: Every year, the Doctoral Course in Geosciences receives a variable number of scholarships from the University.

entry_route.value: A master's degree (or equivalent) is required, plus passing the admission exam.
entry_route.quote: You can access the PhD programme, which lasts 3 or 4 years, only after obtaining a master's degree and passing an admission examination
